name: Lyric Actions & Controls (ENG-17397, k8s-attach)
notes: Attach-only (ADR-0011 Shape-A): pb port-forwards into an already-deployed BYOC lyriclet, never creates a cluster object. Discriminating claim = the stuck-'queued' control-expiry DNW: on the merge SHA a terminal execution stage transition expires the execution's pending stagecontrols to a terminal state, fires the user-action-required email, and an ack-proceed call succeeds; on the parent SHA the stagecontrols are left stuck at 'queued'. conjure.kube_context/namespace are OPERATOR-SUPPLIED placeholders (see RECIPE-NOTES.md) -- even the ticket's own artifacts disagree on them (ready.yaml says redcat/redcat; evidence/20260710-164002/manifest.json says akashpathak/delta), so neither is baked as a real value here. code_identity binds the TICKET-WORKTREE wheel versions co-located with the bound SHAs (not the stale main-worktree values) per docs/lyric-eng17397-recipe-draft.md's versions-disagree finding; conjure must re-derive repos[].sha and wheels[].version from the checked-out tree before sealing any identity from these recipe strings (they are a CLAIM until confirmed). The walk itself (fire, resolve child, drive the terminal stage transition, observe stagecontrols expiry + email + ack) stays agent-proposed and is NOT recipe data. Base-coherence preflight (F2/F3 defense) and operator-ratify gating for the mutating drive verbs are R3-remaining, unbuilt loader surfaces -- not declared here (see RECIPE-NOTES.md); the live run itself needs same-turn human confirmation before any mutating step per CLAUDE.md Risk & autonomy.
intent: On a terminal execution-stage transition, the execution's pending stagecontrols (scoped by executionId) must transition out of 'queued' to a terminal state, the user-action-required email must fire, and an ack-proceed call must succeed. The known parent-SHA bug leaves those stagecontrols stuck at 'queued' after the stage reaches a terminal state -- discriminate on the row-count of stagecontrols {executionId, status:'queued'} for the driven execution's CHILD id: it must fall from >=1 to 0 on a WORKS run and remain >=1 (unchanged) on a DOES_NOT_WORK run.

setup.capture_expectations: echo the PB_DEFAULT_ACTION/PB_OVERRIDE_ACTION/PB_EXPECTED_IMAGE operator env back to stdout as JSON so ratify re-captures them as exports (substituteExports expands $VAR in expect predicates only for CAPTURED exports, never bare env) -- mirrors ready.yaml's capture-expectations verb; a required value left unset must surface as an honest not-run, never a fabricated default.

front_door.serves: the same appservice REST entrypoint lyric-py drives in-pod (all three ids MUST be in the query string; a body-only POST 500s). The minted id is the parent execution _id from the fire response; parent.notes[0] then resolves the child note-exec that carries subActions[]/stages[] and is the executionId stagecontrols are scoped by.

drive.reason: server-side note lifecycle driven over the appservice REST API (POST /executions, PATCH /executions/:id/stages/:stageName) + the mongo stagecontrols tap; the end-user ui-monorepo leg is deferred. The walk (fire, resolve parent.notes[0] -> child id, drive a stage to a terminal state, observe stagecontrols {executionId, status} transition off 'queued', verify the user-action-required email fires, ack-proceed) stays agent-proposed and is never scripted here.
